description: mailbox.rs role_to_wire() uses serde_json::to_value(role) to serialize to String on every call. It is called once per mailbox in handle_mailbox_set's role-uniqueness check (two nested loops over all_mailboxes) and once per mailbox in the filter closure during handle_mailbox_query. For accounts with many mailboxes this allocates a String for each mailbox on each check. An idiomatic fix is a match-based impl returning &'static str, or caching the serialized form alongside the MailboxRole in the type (Display → to_str()). The serde roundtrip to validate wire format is sound reasoning but results in an allocation-per-call in loops.
title: role_to_wire allocates String on every call in a hot filter loop
